title: Rappin'
description: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
description: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
description: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
description: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

title: Monster's Ball
description: A racist prison guard has an affair with a Black woman after her husband, who was sentenced to capital punishment, dies.

title: The Cotton Club
description: The lives of various characters intersect at Harlem's renowned Cotton Club. Handsome horn player Dix Dwyer falls for Vera Cicero, the stunning girlfriend of famous gangster Dutch Schultz.

title: Love and a Bullet
description: Although ordered to kill his boss's girlfriend (Kent Masters-King), a hit man (Treach) develops feelings for her and reflects on his violent past.

title: Soldier Boyz
description: An ex-Marine prison counselor leads juvenile offenders on a mission to rescue a tycoon's daughter held hostage in Vietnam.

title: Eve's Bayou
description: Tragedy strikes a prosperous Louisiana family in 1962 after a girl (Jurnee Smollett) catches her father (Samuel L. Jackson) with another woman.

title: Final Shot: The Hank Gathers Story
description: Inspired by his mother (Nell Carter) and a priest (George Kennedy) in Philadelphia, he (Victor Love) rises to basketball All-American at Loyola Marymount.

title: Fled
description: Escaped convicts (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) fight while they evade authorities seeking a computer disk on Cuban mobsters.

title: Akeelah and the Bee
description: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

title: Beyond the Lights
description: A troubled star and an aspiring politician fall deeply in love, but those around the couple urge them to put their careers ahead of romance.

title: 4Play
description: Unsatisfied with his prior romantic conquests, a Chicago club owner (Wesley Jonathan) tries to juggle relationships with three women at once.

title: A Haunted House
description: Determined not to let a demon ruin his sex life, a man hires a priest, ghostbusters and others to banish an evil spirit from his possessed girlfriend.

title: A Haunted House 2
description: Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) once again finds himself the target of supernatural shenanigans after he, his new girlfriend (Jaime Pressly), and his girlfriend's children move into their dream home.

title: Meet the Blacks
description: A Chicago man (Mike Epps) moves his family to Beverly Hills, Calif., on the same day when all crime becomes legal for a 12-hour period.

title: The Inspection
description: Based on the incredible true story of a gay Black man with few options who joins the Marines to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that cast him aside, unexpectedly finding strength and camaraderie in this new community.

title: Triple Threat
description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

title: Freelancers
description: The son (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) of a fallen police officer joins the NYPD, where he falls in with his father's former partner and a band of rogue cops.

title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
description: A tagger discovers gangsters don't always die hard, an heir to a Texas oil fortune can't afford to stay alive, and a huge rap star finds a few skeletons in his dressing room ... and they are kicking his door down.

title: Black Outside
description: Gary Wilkerson Jr. embarks on the adventure of a lifetime as he hikes 2,600 miles from Mexico to Canada on the Pacific Crest Trail.

title: As Good as Dead
description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

title: Cops and Robbers
description: A hostage negotiator plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a cornered bank robber who is hell-bent on getting out of the bank and humiliating the negotiator in the process.

title: Traffik
description: A couple and their two friends embark on a weekend getaway to an isolated estate in the mountains. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when members of a violent biker gang show up to protect their secrets from the outside world.

title: Cut Throat City
description: When Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, four desperate friends band together to pull off a daring heist in the heart of the city.

title: Slow Burn
description: A district attorney (Ray Liotta) must sort out conflicting stories when his assistant DA and sometime lover (Jolene Blalock) claims that the dead man in her bed tried to rape her, but a witness (LL Cool J) tells a different tale.

title: Caught in the Crossfire
description: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case.

title: Soul Men
description: Old animosities re-emerge when two estranged singers (Samuel L. Jackson, Bernie Mac) travel cross-country to perform in a tribute concert for their late band leader.

title: Mad Money
description: Three women (Diane Keaton, Queen Latifah, Katie Holmes) conspire to steal a pile of cash that the Federal Reserve Bank has earmarked for destruction.

title: Bad Ass 2 : Bad Asses
description: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with his agoraphobic buddy Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to clean up Los Angeles' crime-infested streets.

title: Next Day Air
description: A courier (Donald Faison) lands in the middle of a drug deal gone awry when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address.

title: In the Mix
description: A disc jockey (Usher) must dodge gunfire instead of groupies when he becomes the bodyguard for a mobster's (Chazz Palminteri) beautiful daughter (Emmanuelle Chriqui).

title: Rosemary's Baby
description:
S01 E01 — Night 1
After a personal tragedy, Rosemary and Guy head to Paris, where Guy has landed a teaching job at the Sorbonne; the young couple realize their new apartment has a haunted past.

title: Rosemary's Baby
description:
S01 E02 — Night 2
As Guy finds success, Rosemary's health declines during the course of her pregnancy; Roman and Margaux take a peculiar interest in the couple.

title: Soda Cracker
description: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

title: Foxy Brown
description: A nurse (Pam Grier) takes revenge on a drug ring for the slaying of her undercover-officer boyfriend.

title: Judgment Day
description: In 72 hours a meteor will collide with Earth and annihilate mankind. Singapore's government tells its citizens to let loose for once and do absolutely anything they please.

title: Armed Response
description: Trained operatives find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound after its artificial intelligence is suddenly shut down. There, they begin to experience strange and horrific phenomena.

title: Fifty Shades of Black
description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," wealthy entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) introduces a young woman (Kali Hawk) to his kinky world of S&M.

title: Who's Your Caddy?
description: When members of a stuffy country club oppose his bid to join, a rap mogul (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) buys the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole.

title: Holiday Heart
description: A drag queen (Ving Rhames) mourning the loss of his lover takes in a drug addict (Alfre Woodard) and her daughter (Jessika Quynn Reynolds).

title: Soul Men
description: Old animosities re-emerge when two estranged singers (Samuel L. Jackson, Bernie Mac) travel cross-country to perform in a tribute concert for their late band leader.

title: The Last Letter
description: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

title: Original Gangstas
description: Former gang members return to depressed Gary, Ind., to quell violence perpetrated by their successors.
